detect-link-dog-v3-adaptive.promotion_gate: screen->confirm on the SOT-2305 4-dataset LB holdout (44b6x2 + 6bba x2), independent re-score via the real run_pipeline
detect-link-dog-v3-adaptive.reason: Adaptive robust-intensity threshold (SOT-2307). The DoG-v2 champion kept a fixed percentile (92) of the local-contrast response, i.e. a fixed voxel FRACTION regardless of how many real cells a volume contains; on the sparse 6bba_05b6850b family that predicted 40450 nodes for ~6362 true cells and the node-count penalty crushed its adjusted edge Jaccard to 0.262. Replacing the fixed percentile with a robust per-volume z-score threshold (median + 3.0*1.4826*MAD of the DoG response) tracks each dataset's own noise floor, so the kept-peak COUNT adapts to signal content. On the SOT-2305 4-dataset LB holdout this lifts 6bba_05b6850b from adj 0.262 to 0.502 (pred nodes 40450->13376) while holding both 44b6 families (2-family micro 0.7721->0.7716), raising the holdout micro-avg from 0.5225 to 0.6232 (+0.10). The 6bba_05b6850b matched-edge TP/FP/FN is unchanged (619/251/226) - the whole gain is pruning ~27000 spurious isolated detections the penalty punished, an honest node-count relief not a matching artifact. Screened by cached-candidate sweep (mad_k in {2,3,4} all beat baseline: 0.60/0.62/0.60, a plateau not a spike) and confirmed by an independent re-score through the real run_pipeline. No Kaggle submission.

detect-link-dog-v2.reason: Difference-of-Gaussians (local-contrast) detection replaces the global intensity-percentile threshold. The tracked cell in the fragmented family 44b6_0b24845f sits at ~p60 of the smoothed volume, so a brightness threshold never detects it (recall 8-18% at every percentile); DoG detects it as a compact blob brighter than its local surround (recall 92%). This lifts that family from edge adj 0.044 to 0.662 while the clean family keeps its 47/2/3 edges, raising the local 2-family micro-avg from 0.506 to 0.772. The local 2-family micro-avg reproduces the public LB (0.506 vs 0.509), so this is a measured improvement.

metrics.note: Scored on the single clean GT family only; blind to the fragmented family 44b6_0b24845f, where it scored edge adj 0.044 (consistent with LB 0.509).

detect-link-v1.reason: Classical 3D peak detection (anisotropic Gaussian + NMS + adaptive percentile threshold) plus optimal nearest-neighbour frame linking. First champion (SOT-1983); superseded by detect-link-dog-v2 (SOT-2272).
